description.zh: 富士山是日本最高峰，海拔3,776米，完美的锥形火山轮廓是日本的象征。每年7至8月开放登山，周边的富士五湖提供经典倒影美景。
description.en: At 3,776 m, Mount Fuji is Japan's highest peak. Its perfect conical silhouette is the nation's symbol. Open for climbing July-August; the Fuji Five Lakes provide iconic mirror reflections.

zh: 日本最高峰，3,776米完美锥形火山
7—8月登顶开放，四季各有湖边绝景
en: Japan's highest peak — perfect 3,776 m cone
Summit open July–August; iconic lake views year-round

admission.zh: 登山保全协力金2,000日元（含山梨县侧）

tips.zh: 不登顶也值得来，富士山本宫浅间大社和忍野八海周边风景极佳。登顶建议雇佣向导。
tips.en: Worth visiting even without climbing — Fujisan Hongu Sengen Shrine and Oshino Hakkai offer beautiful close-up views. Hire a guide if summiting.

name.zh: 伊豆半岛世界地质公园

description.zh: 伊豆半岛原本是菲律宾海板块上的一座火山岛，约200万年前与本州碰撞合并，留下了丰富的火山、断层和海蚀地貌。同时以温泉、海鲜和文学（夏目漱石、川端康成等人的作品背景）著称。
description.en: The Izu Peninsula was originally a volcanic island on the Philippine Sea Plate that collided with Honshu approximately two million years ago, leaving a rich legacy of volcanic, fault and marine erosion landforms. It is also celebrated for hot springs, seafood and literary associations with Natsume Soseki and Kawabata Yasunari.

location.zh: 静冈县伊豆半岛（伊豆市、下田市等）
location.en: Izu Peninsula, Shizuoka Prefecture (Izu City, Shimoda, etc.)

zh: 堂ヶ島：玄武岩柱状节理与天然洞穴，乘船游览
城ヶ崎海岸：火山熔岩形成的海蚀断崖，吊桥步道
伊豆の国・大室山：火山渣丘，缆车登顶360°环形步道
en: Dogashima: basalt columnar jointing and sea caves, best seen by boat
Jogasaki Coast: sea cliffs carved from lava flows, with suspension bridge trail
Omuroyama (Izu-no-Kuni): scoria cone with ropeway and 360° circular summit trail

admission.zh: 大室山缆车约700日元；各景点免费或少量收费
admission.en: Omuroyama ropeway ~¥700; other sites free or nominal charge

tips.zh: 东京乘特急踊り子约2小时到修善寺，是伊豆最方便的入口。半岛整体驾车游览效率更高，建议租车。
tips.en: The Odoriko limited express from Tokyo reaches Shuzenji in about 2 hours — the most convenient entry point. Driving is more efficient for exploring the whole peninsula.
